Lighting matches the style reference: warm amber key light from below and in front (a glowing chart table she stands behind), soft cool blue-grey rim light from a viewport behind her. Same matte-painted style and brushwork. True transparent background, including negative spaces; no ground, floor, cast shadow slab, table, border, text or other people.
